title: Context Stash Plugin Config
description: Configuration for the Axiom context-stash OpenCode plugin. Phase 4 config adoption complete (context-stash-config-adoption, 2026-05-17): context-stash now reads config via loadPluginConfig() from .opencode/config/context-stash.json (Layer 2), .opencode/config/context-stash.local.json (Layer 3), and AXIOM_CONTEXT_STASH_* env vars (Layer 4 — highest priority). If .axiom/axiom.config.yaml has a stash: section and no context-stash.json exists, a MIGRATION REQUIRED warning is emitted at plugin startup. See specs/112-Plugin-Config-Management.md §8.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the context-stash plugin.

storage_path.description: Root directory for stash files, relative to repo root. Configure via .axiom/axiom.config.yaml stash.storage_path.

active_size_limit_kb.description: Maximum size of a single active stash file in KB. Set to 0 to disable size limit (unlimited). Configure via .axiom/axiom.config.yaml stash.active_size_limit_kb.

compaction.description: Auto-compaction settings for active stash files.

auto.description: Enable automatic compaction when active stash exceeds active_size_limit_kb.

keep_types.description: Log entry types to retain during compaction.

keep_recent.description: Number of most recent log entries to always retain during compaction.

snapshot_before.description: Save a snapshot of the stash before compaction.

suspend_ttl_days.description: Days before a suspended stash is auto-archived.

closed_ttl_days.description: Days before a closed stash is auto-archived.

archive_retain_days.description: Days to retain archived stashes before deletion.

default_log_level.description: Default log level for managed context stashes.

log_tool_categories.description: Tool categories to auto-log in managed context mode.

max_simultaneous_active.description: Maximum number of simultaneously active managed-context stashes.

git.description: Git integration settings for stash tracking.

track_active.description: Track active stash files in git. Default false (credential safety).

track_suspended.description: Track suspended stash files in git. Default false (REQ-STASH-NEW-006: MUST default false).
